03 / KEEP IT

Save & take it with you

Save to this browser or keep a portable copy you can reopen on another device. No account needed.

Browser saves can be cleared. Download an editable file to keep a reliable backup.

PDF uses your browser's print dialog. Choose “Save as PDF” or print on paper; charts are tiled into readable sections. Markdown includes written round instructions.

Before you cast on

These are experimental knitting instructions, not test-knitted patterns. Check your gauge, yarn quantities, motif alignment, and floats before a full project. Colorwork may need caught floats. Every v1 round preserves stitch count; no increases, decreases, cables, or lace.
